description.en: This is the Catalan EuroWordNet-Lemon lexicon. The lexicon was created from the Catalan Word-Net-LMF lexicon which is part of the Multilingual Central Repository (MCR http://adimen.si.ehu.es/web/MCR). The lexicon conforms to the 'lemon' specifications and it is linked to the Catalan Parole/Simple lemon lexicon (http://lod.iula.upf.edu/resources/metadata_SimpleParole-Catalanv2).
